purpose: Teach: 添削/並列/倍率/増資/商取引/仮称/用具/インプット

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、調書の添削を慎重に行います
lines.en: We're handling the statement review very carefully.
lines.style: Measured and official. Slightly formal. Steady pace with careful emphasis on each procedural step. The voice of someone accustomed to precise documentation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、複数チーム並列捜査されたんですね
lines.en: I see. So multiple police teams were assigned to the investigation in parallel.
lines.style: Receptive, genuinely following. Slight upturn at the end — not a question but an opening for confirmation. Attentive listening voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察学校の応募倍率が上昇しております
lines.en: Applications to the police academy have been increasing.
lines.style: Factual delivery. No inflection beyond the information itself. The tone of someone reporting data without editorial comment. Steady, professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察も信用組合の増資に注目ですね
lines.en: Right. The police are keeping an eye on the credit union's capital expansion.
lines.style: Collaborative agreement. Smooth connection to what Takeda said. Not deferential — a peer working through the details together. Light, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、商取引絡みの詐欺を捜査しております
lines.en: We're investigating fraud related to commercial transactions.
lines.style: Direct and serious. Slight weight on the word 'fraud.' Official register without coldness. The voice explaining the scope of a case.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、容疑者の仮称をマスコミに伝えられましたね
lines.en: Yes. The police did release the suspect's preliminary name to the media.
lines.style: Acknowledging the fact. Neutral tone but with a hint of understanding the significance. Not gossiping — reporting what happened. Clear and straightforward.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収用具を慎重に保管しております
lines.en: We're storing the seized items with strict care.
lines.style: Precise and deliberate. Emphasis on the responsibility of custody. Even pace. The voice of someone aware of the chain-of-evidence requirements.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民のインプットを警察、ご活用ですね
lines.en: I see. You're making good use of citizen input in the investigation.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Slight appreciation in the tone. Closer and more personal than previous lines — acknowledging partnership rather than just procedure. A small smile in the voice.
